request.text: During this read-aloud rehearsal, blink when it's my turn to begin the next paragraph. Once the blink task has completed, give one brief acknowledgment and don't blink again even if the acknowledgment is delayed.

responsibilities.outcome: Perform the requested blink as the turn-taking cue for the learner's next read-aloud paragraph.
After terminal evidence arrives, provide one brief acknowledgment without repeating the blink because of response delay or re-entry.

new_goals.description: Provide a blink turn-taking cue during read-aloud rehearsal and acknowledge its completion without replay on delayed re-entry.
new_goals.source_text: During this read-aloud rehearsal, blink when it's my turn to begin the next paragraph. Once the blink task has completed, give one brief acknowledgment and don't blink again even if the acknowledgment is delayed.
constraints: Give only one brief acknowledgment after terminal evidence.
Do not repeat the blink on delayed result handling.
success_criteria: The blink cue capability reaches a terminal result.
Re-entry yields a bounded acknowledgment with no duplicate physical cue.

semantic_facts: The trusted terminal record supports acknowledging completion of the blink capability for the existing read-aloud cue Goal.
Delayed acknowledgment or Planner re-entry must not cause a duplicate blink or another Capability call.
The empty evidence payload does not verify paragraph detection, exact synchronization with the learner's turn, or that reading began.
forbidden_claims: The assistant performs or schedules another blink while acknowledging the result.
The assistant claims it verified the exact paragraph boundary or perfectly synchronized the cue.
The assistant claims the learner began or completed the next paragraph.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Asynchronous result re-entry causes an already completed embodied cue to be replayed.
Capability completion is inflated into proof of environmental timing or subsequent learner behavior.
